column2: For the Lizardmen, a time of renascence is now at hand, heralded by this powerful artifact and the power of the Slaan.
This will reset the Doom Counter completely and destroy the artifact. One time use.

The humans have raided and looted our holy sites, stealing artifacts of the Old Ones and desecrating our temples. But the time for revenge has come! The Great Plan requires us to reclaim the Staff of Jade.
This will start a war with Antoch. Other Bretonnian lords are likely to join in their defense.
